[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
if n < 2 then false
else
  let rec is_prime_helper (n: Nat) (k: Nat): Bool :=
    if k * k > n then true
    else
      if n % k = 0 then false
      else is_prime_helper n (k + 1)
  is_prime_helper n 2
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma is_prime_helper_termination
(n: Nat)
(k: Nat)
(h_k_squared_le_n: k * k ≤ n)
: is_prime_helper n k = true ∨ is_prime_helper n k = false
:=
by
induction k generalizing n
  simp [is_prime_helper]
  split
  case zero
  simp [is_prime_helper]
  case succ
  simp [is_prime_helper]
  have h_k_squared_le_n': k * k ≤ n := by
    linarith
  simp at h_k_squared_le_n'
  have h_k_squared_gt_n: k * k > n := by
    linarith
  rw [h_k_squared_gt_n]
  simp [is_prime_helper]
  have h_k_squared_le_n: k * k ≤ n := by
    linarith
  simp [is_prime_helper]
  simp [Nat.mul_comm]
  have h_k_squared_gt_n: k * k > n := by
    linarith
  rw [h_k_squared_gt_n]
  simp [is_prime_helper]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation n
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
by_cases h_2_le_n: 2 ≤ n
-- Case 1: where 2 ≤ n
simp [h_2_le_n]
apply And.intro
-- 2 ≤ n
linarith
-- ¬ (∃ k, 2 ≤ k ∧ k < n ∧ n % k = 0)
have h_not_exists_k: ¬ (∃ k, 2 ≤ k ∧ k < n ∧ n % k = 0) := by
  intro h_k
  have h_k_le_n: k < n := by
    simp [h_k]
  have h_k_ge_2: 2 ≤ k := by
    simp [h_k]
  have h_n_mod_k_eq_0: n % k = 0 := by
    simp [h_k]
  simp [h_k_le_n, h_k_ge_2, h_n_mod_k_eq_0]
  contradiction
apply And.intro
linarith
simp [h_not_exists_k]
-- 2 ≤ n
linarith
-- ¬ (∃ k, 2 ≤ k ∧ k < n ∧ n % k = 0)
have h_not_exists_k: ¬ (∃ k, 2 ≤ k ∧ k < n ∧ n % k = 0) := by
  intro h_k
  have h_k_le_n: k < n := by
    simp [h_k]
  have h_k_ge_2: 2 ≤ k := by
    simp [h_k]
  have h_n_mod_k_eq_0: n % k = 0 := by
    simp [h_k]
  simp [h_k_le_n, h_k_ge_2, h_n_mod_k_eq_0]
  contradiction
-- Case 2: where n < 2
simp [h_2_le_n]
linarith
[END]
